{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' once attended the [[Rigovian Technical University]] with [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], a prominent engineer during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was involved in the design of a [[Ugly assassin droid|model]] of [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], though the model was a failure due to its obvious appearance, and that they were prone to [[Death/Legends|kill]] their owners. At some point prior to or during [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], she was killed by one of these droids.<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was mentioned in [[Greg Bear]]'s ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', a novel released in [[May]] [[2000]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
